listing.name: Rebalance and CTD fix for gundam UC
listing.summary: Hey guys i did a quick and dirty of the mod without source but its playable and the CTD should be patched EDIT UPDATED TO Update 2! You can find the download below. EDIT: Added two new files to the link, Update 3 and a unchanged gundam UC with the CTD fix!
listing.aiSummary: Rebalances units and fixes crashes for the Gundam UC mod.

description:
Hey guys i did a quick and dirty of the mod without source but its playable and the CTD should be patched EDIT UPDATED TO Update 2! You can find the download below. EDIT: Added two new files to the link, Update 3 and a unchanged gundam UC with the CTD fix!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WQVrdxUN_qU5yklYFG_ZmPb2Geg87KgK?usp=drive_link

Im in the discord. Username Kitsume Pillow int he modding channel. I will update based on balance requests and stuff too.

The CTD fix is simply replacing the broken industry with a copy paste of the planetary shield system any other crashes ill try to fix but i do not have the source to fix.

There was an Issue with Zaku 2 not leaving carrier like a support fighter i hope to have fixed it but ill find out later. Hope you enjoy!

EDIT: Lowered all wings health and armor and changed speed now zeon is more fragile but very fast and the EFSF is tankier then zeon but hit a certain kinda way. OP for wings reduced! Fighters given new systems! Gundams got plasma jets, Zeon gets Fuller Auto from ARMAA and ESFS Get Manuv Jets! DEFENSE CHANGED Zeon gets boosters and sniper get phase, EFSF gets shields!

There are still balance issues but i think i have the broad strokes of what im looking for balance wise.

Link to original mod and post https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=24162.0 requirments still apply but modern versions are good.

aiDescription: Rebalances unit stats, speeds, and defenses to improve gameplay. Fixes a crash-to-desktop issue by replacing a broken industry system. Includes both a rebalanced version and an original version with only the crash fix.
